instruction: A riverbank cut section: a sloped muddy bank descending to a flat water plane, clumps of tall reeds along the waterline, eroded soil transitions, and a line of thin survey stakes along the top. Meter units, north-forward.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a riverbank cut. A riverbank cut section: a sloped muddy bank descending to a flat water plane, clumps of tall reeds along the waterline, eroded soil transitions, and a line of thin survey stakes along the top. Meter units, north-forward. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
